extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent practitioners, stakeholders, and technical experts interested in USPTO outreach or ombudsman assistance
extracted.subtask_short: patent stakeholder outreach and ombudsman use
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing the USPTO Stakeholder Outreach and Patents Ombudsman Program: what services they provide to help patent applications and applicants, how inquiries are handled and measured, and opportunities to provide technical training to examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer service priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Customer service is a hallmark of the Patents organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SOPOP is presented as a customer-focused office; interactions and processes should prioritize customer service and customer satisfaction when handling patent-related inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of assistance (getting applications back on track)
rubrics_metrics.description: SOPOP can help patent applications get back on track – whether your concern is with the initial filing of your patent application, how your application is being examined, or post examination practice that leads to your patent issuing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SOPOP for problems at filing, during examination, or in post-examination practice; the office can answer questions or direct issues to where they can be resolved.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-to-end inquiry monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Each inquiry is monitored through completion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inquiries submitted to SOPOP are tracked from receipt until resolution; users can expect their matter to be followed through rather than a one-off response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue clearance rate / timeliness monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: We monitor our issue clearance rate to ensure our timeliness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timeliness is measured via an issue clearance-rate metric; responsiveness and timely resolution are explicit operational goals of the office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incident tracking and trend analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: By incident tracking, this Office not only ensures complete issue handling to our customer’s satisfaction but also allows us to perform incident management and inquiry-based trend analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office records incidents to (a) ensure satisfactory resolution of individual cases and (b) analyze recurring issues to inform broader practice tips or process improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver timely patent examination practice tips
rubrics_metrics.description: A goal of Stakeholder Outreach is to bring our stakeholders timely patent examination practice tips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholder Outreach gathers common questions/solutions and proactively shares practice tips and lessons learned through scheduled outreach events and visits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection and dissemination of stakeholder-informed information
rubrics_metrics.description: By tracking inquiries and solutions that flow through the Patents Ombudsman Program, Stakeholder Outreach collects a wealth of timely information most asked by our external stakeholders today.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information collected from inquiries is used to identify frequently asked questions and to inform outreach content; stakeholders may request visits or events to receive this information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure process integrity and customer understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: The Patents Ombudsman Program ensures that the patent application process is working the way it is intended and that each customer understands the pathway forward for their patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ombudsman assistance focuses on verifying that procedures are functioning properly and on explaining next steps to applicants so they understand how their matter will progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-circumvention of normal examination process
rubrics_metrics.description: The Program does not circumvent the normal patent examination process but our staff can answer questions about the process and/or direct your questions to where they can be solved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should not expect the Ombudsman to bypass or alter official examination procedures; the role is advisory, explanatory, and referral-focused rather than an override of examiner decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typical inquiry topics handled
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions are typically about the status of a patent application, how to file certain papers, details about provisional applications, and other more general questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may consult the Ombudsman for procedural/status questions, filing guidance, and general information about application types (e.g., provisional applications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Examiner Technical Training Program (PETTP) criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: PETTP offers technologists, scientists, engineers, and other experts from industry and academia an opportunity to voluntarily provide technical training and expertise to patent examiners in-person or virtually from their own location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject-matter experts (from industry or academia) may volunteer to deliver technical presentations to examiners; presentations can be given in-person at specified USPTO locations or virtually, expanding examiner technical awareness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formats and locations for technical training
rubrics_metrics.description: In-person presentations can be made at our Alexandria, Virginia headquarters or at one of our satellite offices in Detroit, Michigan and Denver, Colorado.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training providers should plan for in-person delivery at listed USPTO sites or virtual delivery from their own location; check PETTP page for more details and scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participation in patents events and training
rubrics_metrics.description: Interested in taking part in additional Patent lead training and other public events? Please visit the Patents Events page to learn more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders and experts seeking broader engagement should consult the Patents Events page for opportunities to participate in USPTO-led training and outreach activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and routing guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: For inquiries about stakeholder outreach opportunities, email PatentQuality@uspto.gov. For inquiries about your patent application, please refer to the Patents Ombudsman Program webpage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified email for outreach/partnership queries; for application-specific issues or status questions use the Ombudsman webpage and its contact mechanisms.
